architecture.summary: SO-04 adds two components and one public module: the new owner sql (src/runtime/sql/) takes the bounded SQL runtime unchanged from audit-logs (a git rename) and becomes the only owner that imports pg, with the runtime as its public module; the new owner tenants (src/tenancy/tenants/) holds the tenant registry of the control plane. App now opens the one runtime and gives it to the settings and removal adapter of audit-logs, which keeps only a type edge, and to the registry: one role (thermus_logging) and one pool. New edges: app to sql and to tenants (runtime), audit-logs and tenants to sql (type). The tenant request is one idempotent insert of a requested row: under a SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock on thermus_admin.tenants it counts the rows by state and inserts only for an organization without a row and with a free place under FREE_TENANT_LIMIT, where every row except failed and deleted holds a place; at a full cap it inserts nothing and answers full. The lookup gives the state and internal address from an in-memory copy that it reads on demand: after 10 s it reads again, after a failed read it serves the copy up to 60 s, then answers unavailable; it opens no connection at startup. The hosted start reads FREE_TENANT_LIMIT (0 to 1000, default 25, 0 closes free signup through the cap); an invalid value stops the start with a FATAL line that names the rule. Flags: component and internalInterface for the owners and edges; container and contract because the PostgreSQL datastore gains three tables (tenants, subscriptions, billing_events) with checks and grants, and operators get a new start setting; deployment because the migration must precede any caller and the registry shares the existing pool; crossCutting because SQL access and pg move to one shared owner for every store. Nothing calls the registry yet (the gateway of SO-05 and signup of SO-07 will), the migration is not applied to Supabase (SO-12 applies it), and no Render, WorkOS, or Stripe call is added.
